title: The 30-second posture reset
headline: The 30-Second Posture Reset
caption:
Shoulders creeping up towards your ears? 🧣

Colder days and darker evenings make most of us curl in, hunched over a laptop or tucked up on the sofa.

Try this quick posture reset:

1. Sit tall with your feet flat on the floor.
2. Breathe in and gently lift your shoulders up towards your ears.
3. Breathe out and slide them back and down, as if tucking them into your back pockets.
4. Let your chin draw back slightly, so the back of your neck feels long.

Repeat 3 to 5 times whenever you notice yourself slumping. Keep it gentle, and stop if anything feels painful.

This is the everyday strength and awareness we build in reformer and Mat Pilates in Clitheroe.

Save this post for your next long evening on the sofa 📌
